scripts.build: npm run clean && npx tsc -p . && mv ../../lib/functions/functions/* ../../lib/functions/ 2>/dev/null || true && mv ../../lib/functions/lib/* ../../lib/functions/ 2>/dev/null || true && rm -rf ../../lib/functions/functions ../../lib/functions/lib 2>/dev/null || true && find ../../lib/functions -type f -name '*.js' -exec sed -i 's|@/lib/|./|g' {} + && cp package.json ../../lib/functions/
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
